description: Start a full scan of a public website that the user names. The scan requests each page the way common search and AI crawlers do, compares each response with a rendered browser view, and scores six SEO, AEO and GEO categories. Each scan counts against the user's monthly plan quota. Returns a scan_id. A scan takes 1 to 5 minutes. By default the site is added to the user's sites on the dashboard. Set add_to_sites to false for a site that is not the user's own (a prospect, a client lead or a competitor): the scan is saved, the site is not added.

add_to_sites.description: Default true. False runs a one-off scan and does not add the site to the user's dashboard.

name: scan_site
title: Start an AI visibility scan
